articles.title_en: Ranking the Greatest Fantasy Premier League Icons
articles.preview_en: Experts rank the most iconic Fantasy Premier League picks based on performance and fan impact.
articles.preview_ru: Эксперты оценивают самые знаковые выборы ФПЛ по результатам и влиянию на фанатов.
articles.full_en: Fans of fantasy football are captivated by the debate over who deserves the title of greatest icon. The analysis ranks players such as Harry Kane, Jamie Vardy, and Marcus Rashford based on points, consistency, and transfer value. These icons emerged during pivotal seasons when their clubs achieved historic success in the Premier League. Their influence extends beyond the virtual league, inspiring real‑world tactics and player valuations. The rankings highlight how fantasy performance can shape a player's legacy and commercial appeal. Team managers can use the insights to refine squad selection and budget allocation for upcoming seasons. Ultimately, the conversation reminds players that every point scored can echo in both fantasy and reality.
articles.full_ru: Любители ФПЛ погружаются в дискуссию о том, кто заслуживает звание величайшей иконы. В рейтинге фигурируют такие игроки, как Гарри Кейн, Джейми Варди и Маркус Рашфорд, оцененные по очкам, стабильности и стоимости. Эти иконы проявили себя в ключевых сезонах, когда их клубы достигли исторических побед в ПремьерЛиге. Их влияние выходит за пределы виртуальной арены, формируя реальные тактики и ценность игроков. Рейтинг подчёркивает, как показатели в ФПЛ могут влиять на наследие и коммерческую привлекательность спортсмена. Менеджеры команд могут использовать эти данные для улучшения состава и распределения бюджета в предстоящих сезонах. В итоге, обсуждение напоминает, что каждое очко в ФПЛ звучит как реальный вклад в карьеру игрока.

articles.title_en: The best life hack I've ever heard? Monetise what you're bad at | Polly Hudson
articles.title_ru: The best life hack I've ever heard? Monetise what you're bad at | Polly Hudson
articles.preview_en: Phil Heckels has turned his awful pet portraits into a full-time job.
articles.preview_ru: Phil Heckels has turned his awful pet portraits into a full-time job.
articles.full_en: Phil Heckels has turned his awful pet portraits into a full-time job. As a blueprint for success, embracing your lack of talent has obvious appeal What do you get if you cross a complete lack of artistic talent with making lemonade out of life’s lemons? Phil Heckels, that’s what – or, rather, who. The former estate agent from West Sussex has turned being bad at drawing animals into a full-time job after posting a hilariously terrible portrait of his dog on social media. Friends started asking him to do awful pictures of their pets, word spread, and he’s now received more than 100,000 requests. His rules are that he only sees the photos immediately before he picks up his pen, he never restarts a drawing, and he doesn’t spend longer than 10 minutes on a creation. He also refuses to charge for his artworks – suggesting charity donations instead – but makes money through merchandise and books.
